properties.project_name: 3E -- plan block east of Venue, toward 3rd St
properties.digitized_from: A construction by Pier & Point, not a hand trace: the east edge of Venue's outline as fitted to a rectangle (72.07m, the edge facing 3rd St), extended east as a rectangle of the same length and orientation and widened until it reaches the 3rd St curb line as estimated from DataSF's official street centerlines (half-width 6.8m).
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had 3E absorbed into Venue -- 'the real building spans the plan's 3W/3E line as one development, not two'). The owner identified 3E as a separate real plan block east of Venue, initially pointing at real-gap-fragments 6+7 (a jagged sliver hugging a structure visible in satellite imagery between Venue and 3rd St). Construction went through two corrections from the owner: (1) an axis-aligned bounding box of fragments 6+7 wrongly cut across Venue's own diagonal orientation and overlapped neighboring land -- corrected by using Venue's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge as the shared border instead, matching its exact length (72.07m) and rotation, with depth set so the area matched fragments 6+7 (3,030 sqm); (2) the owner then directed widening the rectangle further east to the real 3rd St curb line rather than stopping at the fragment-matched depth, giving the final 4,682 sqm shown here. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: citation only, no change to the shape, status or use (owner decisions). The OCII Mission Bay Land Use Map (Dec 2019, now in source_doc_urls) shows plan block 3E immediately east of 3W between Mission Rock St and the VARA strip, shaded Residential / Affordable, while 3W (Venue's block) is shaded Residential / Market Rate; so the accuracy_caveat's phrase 'matching Venue' does not hold for affordability. Nothing cited in this file supports the 'structure visible in satellite imagery' or the 'planned' status, and public reports (SF YIMBY, May 2021) describe an affordable-housing building at 1150 3rd St, the Edwin M. Lee Apartments, completed around 2021 in Mission Bay South; whether 3E is that building, and therefore whether status 'planned' is right, is left for the owner to decide with a cited source. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (owner-directed construction: shares Venue's real east edge and orientation, widened to the real 3rd St curb line) not a hand trace or surveyed footprint. Esri satellite imagery shows what appears to be a real structure across much of this area (a roof pattern resembling built construction, not open land or a parking lot), but its name, address, and completion status are NOT confirmed by any source checked in this pass -- flagged here rather than guessed. status/use are carried over from the OCII plan designation (a residential block on the 3W/3E line, matching Venue), not independently confirmed for this specific structure.'; digitized_from: 'Owner-directed construction, not a hand trace: Venue's own minimum-rotated-rectangle east edge (72.07m, the edge facing 3rd St) extended east as a rectangle of the same length and orientation, widened until it reaches the real 3rd St curb line (src/street_geometry.py buffer, half-width 6.8m).'; notes: 'OCII plan block 3E. East of Venue (1155 4th St / 3W), toward 3rd St. Previously assumed absorbed into Venue's own footprint; the owner's review found it real and separate.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- an idealized rectangle (constructed by Pier & Point: it shares Venue's real east edge and orientation, widened to the real 3rd St curb line) not a hand trace or surveyed footprint. Esri satellite imagery shows what appears to be a real structure across much of this area (a roof pattern resembling built construction, not open land or a parking lot), but its name, address, and completion status are NOT confirmed by any source checked -- flagged here rather than guessed. Its status and use are carried over from the OCII plan designation (a residential block on the 3W/3E line, matching Venue), not independently confirmed for this specific structure.
properties.notes: OCII plan block 3E. East of Venue (1155 4th St / 3W), toward 3rd St. Previously assumed absorbed into Venue's own footprint; a later review by Pier & Point found it real and separate.
